import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def find_nearest_minimum_distance(n, array):
    min_value = min(array)
    min_positions = [i for i, value in enumerate(array) if value == min_value]
    
    min_distance = float('inf')
    for i in range(1, len(min_positions)):
        min_distance = min(min_distance, min_positions[i] - min_positions[i - 1])
    
    return min_distance

data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
array = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))

print(find_nearest_minimum_distance(n, array))
